decisions.quote:
The
results confirm that we could achieve around 90%
precision and recall rates using commit and developer
communication information on Apache Derby and CXF
projects. However, these ratios are highly dependent on
the level of granularity in which performance metrics
are calculated. If a developer wants to see during a
commit, which files will also be changed with the file
that she is currently editing, predictor models could only
recommend 59-76% of the files.
decisions.reason: When evaluating their models using Wiese et al.'s aggregate file-pair metric calculation, the authors explicitly confirm the original ~90% precision and recall findings. However, the paper's central methodological argument is that this file-pair evaluation granularity is biased and does not represent practical commit-level change recommendation, where precision and recall drop substantially.
